name: Sven Hardy Benson’s Shelf
description: The public library of author and independent researcher Sven Hardy Benson, writing across intelligence, institutions, markets, medicine, infrastructure, energy, and fast-moving technology.
kicker: Sven Hardy Benson · Author and independent researcher
lede: Sven Hardy Benson writes about intelligence, institutions, markets, medicine, infrastructure, energy, and the systems people build around fast-moving technology. His books follow what changes when rules, capabilities, and incentives shift — and what humans can still choose to do about it.
